newsitem.title: USA: Haemonetics sees lower Q3 net, higher sales.
newsitem.headline: Haemonetics sees lower Q3 net, higher sales.

text.p: Haemonetics Corp said on Tuesday that it expects earnings per share for the third quarter ended December 1996 to be about 10 to 20 percent below the $0.32 reported in last year's third quarter.
Third quarter sales are expected to grow 10 percent from the year ago period's $69.9 million, Haemonetics said.

The decrease in profits was due to increased pricing pressures worldwide, an increase in its lower margin plasma business, and the company's continued investment in building its services businesses, the company said.
Haemonetics said it expects pricing pressures and the increased market demand for plasma will continue.

Also, the company will continue to form investment initiatives with its key blood bank partners to fuel the growth of its service business. The investments will put pressure on operating margins for the next several quarters, the company said.
Haemonetics plans to release a full accounting of the quarter on January 14, 1997.
